name: @pipeworx/mcp-lens-org

tools.name: patents_search
tools.description: Search Lens.org patent database by free-text or Lucene query (requires Bearer token); returns up to 1000 patent records with title, applicant, filing date, and claims.

tools.name: scholarly_search
tools.description: Search Lens.org scholarly works (academic papers, preprints) by free-text or Lucene query (requires Bearer token); returns title, authors, journal, year, and DOI.

tools.name: patent
tools.description: Fetch a single Lens.org patent record by its lens_id (requires Bearer token); returns full bibliographic data including claims, inventors, and priority dates.

tools.name: scholarly
tools.description: Fetch a single Lens.org scholarly work by its lens_id (requires Bearer token); returns full metadata including abstract, authors, citations, and open-access links.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-lens-org forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the lens-org pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
